question: According to the passage, it can be inferred that a camera:
solution:
The correct answer is **option 4) i.e. '****often lies'.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **first sentence of the fifth paragraph** says "The idea that the camera never lies is as misleading as the notion that all statistics are meant to mislead."
 
• The **second sentence of the fifth**** paragraph** says "the camera and then the photograph can be - and is often - manipulated."
 
• The **first sentence of the sixth paragraph** says "a photograph can be manipulated in more ways - and more effectively - to convey a false reality..."
 
• From the above sentence, we can say that **cameras and photographs are often manipulated to create false narratives or lies.**

 

Hence,** the only possible answer is option 4.**
